headlines.title: 중국만 배불리던 전기차 규정 … ‘ 국내생산 세액공제’ 지각 논의
headlines.summary: 작년부터 입법 추진했지만 답보 테슬라 등 韓 전기차시장 장악 이달 국회 조세소위서 심사 예정 이르면 내달 본회의 상정 기대 여야 “자국 산업 보호” 한목소리 정치권이 연내 국회 통과를 목표로 국산 전기차에 생산세액공제를 도입하기 위한 법 개정 추진을 본격화할 방침이어서 주목된다.

headlines.title: 中 공세에 벼랑끝 내몰린 전기차 …“ 생산세액공제 추가 시급 ”
headlines.summary: 전기차, 세제개편안 6대 분야서 소외 22대 국회 24건 발의, 11월 국회 논의 “주요국 관세·보조금 동원” 대응촉구 업계, 일본 수준 대당 400만원 지원안 이형일(왼쪽) 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관과 정의선 현대차그룹 회장이 2일 경기 화성 현대차 남양연구소에서 면담에 앞서 악수하며 기념사진을 찍고 있다.

headlines.title: 과반 무너진 국산 전기차 …" 전기차도 세액공제 포함해야 "
headlines.summary: 올해 중국 전기차 점유율 43.5%…여야, 국정감사서 한 목소리 지원 촉구 국내생산세액공제 전기차 포함 법안 24건 발의…"마중물 역할 지원해야" (서울=연합뉴스) 장하나 기자 = 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 이달 중에 '전기차 산업 경쟁력 강화 방안'을 마련해 발표하겠다고 밝힌 가운데 자동차 업계뿐 아니라 국회에서도 여야를 막론하고 국내생산세액공제

headlines.title: 10월 소비자물가 상승 률 2.8% ↑… 가공식품·석유류 '들썩 '
headlines.summary: 소비자물가 상승률이 두 달 연속 2%대 후반을 유지했다. 농축수산물 가격은 내렸지만 가공식품과 석유류는 오름세를 이어갔다. 지난달 소비자물가지수는 120.73(2020년=100)으로 작년 동월 대비 2.8% 오른 것으로 국가데이터처가 3일 발표한 '10월 소비자물가 동향'에 나타났다.

headlines.title: 10월물가 2.8% 고공행진 …기름 더 붓는 ‘역대급 예산’
headlines.summary: 서민들 ‘이중고’ 불가피 3일 서울 시내 한 대형마트 식품 매대에서 소비자들이 장을 보고 있다. 뉴시스 10월 소비자물가 상승률이 2.8%를 기록해 석유가격 중심의 고물가 흐름이 이어졌다. 정부가 역대급 예산에 이어 미래대응기금을 통한 돈 풀기에 나설 방침이어서 물가 상승세에 기름을 부을 수 있다는 우려가 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부 " 체감 물가 여전히 높아...역대 최대 규모 김장 대책 "
headlines.summary: 권대영 재정경제부 제1차관은 물가관계차관회의를 주재하고 누적된 물가 상승 여파로 체감 물가가 여전히 높다고 진단했습니다. 권 차관은 10월 소비자물가 상승률이 2.8%로 발표된 것을 두고 가공식품 등이 올랐으나 농·축·수산물 가격이 전년 대비 하락하면서 전월보다 둔화됐다고 평가했습니다. 하지만 체감 물가는 지표 물가와 동떨어져 있다는 게 정부의 판단입니다.

key_headlines.title: October Consumer Price Inflation Reaches 2.8% on Rising Processed Food and Oil Prices
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's consumer price inflation maintained the late 2% range for a second consecutive month in October, driven primarily by increases in processed foods and petroleum products despite lower agricultural prices.

key_headlines.title: Government Pursues Domestic EV Tax Credit to Counter Market Dominance by Tesla and Chinese Manufacturers
key_headlines.summary: South Korean lawmakers are accelerating efforts to introduce production tax credits for domestically-produced electric vehicles, with parliamentary review scheduled this month and expected floor vote next month to protect local industry.

key_headlines.title: CPTPP Mega Trade Pact Covers 12 Nations Representing 14% of Global GDP with 98.8% Tariff Elimination
key_headlines.summary: The comprehensive CPTPP trade agreement encompasses 12 member nations with nearly complete tariff elimination across goods, digital services, labor, and environmental standards, representing a significant trade bloc that accounts for 25% of South Korea's annual trade.

key_headlines.title: Construction Industry Demands Revision of Nuclear Power Plant Contract Terms with Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power
key_headlines.summary: The government has begun gathering opinions on revising special contract terms for nuclear projects to address construction companies' concerns about bearing costs from design changes and construction delays affecting projects like Shin Kori units 3 and 4.

key_headlines.title: Next Year's Tax Revenue Projected to Increase by 113 Trillion Won Driven by Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: Corporate tax is expected to account for 74% of next year's additional tax revenue surge of 113 trillion won, buoyed by the semiconductor industry boom, though tax increases are anticipated to significantly decline from 2028 onwards.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's October consumer inflation rose 2.8% year-over-year, maintaining momentum in the late 2% range with particular pressure from processed food and petroleum prices. The government is preparing unprecedented budget allocations and stimulus measures that have raised concerns about accelerating inflation. Simultaneously, lawmakers are advancing domestic EV tax credit legislation to counter foreign dominance in Korea's electric vehicle market. These economic crosscurrents reflect competing pressures between inflation control and stimulus spending amid industrial policy priorities.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Australia's central bank raised its benchmark rate to 4.85%, marking the fifth increase this year and reaching the highest level in 18 years, despite economic growth deceleration and rising unemployment. South Korea's government is focusing next year's budget on enhancing potential growth rates and mitigating K-shaped inequality, emphasizing broad-based income growth rather than selective prosperity. Tax revenue forecasts have been upgraded substantially with semiconductor sector strength driving a projected 113 trillion won increase in next year's collections, dominated by corporate tax gains.
sections.Financial Markets: U.S. Treasury markets strengthened as Democratic Party early performance in midterm elections prompted bond yield declines, with the 10-year rate remaining near 4.93%. South Korea's KOSPI index retreated from initial 1% gains while KOSDAQ fell below 700 points amid U.S. midterm election uncertainty and lingering interest rate concerns. The dollar-won exchange rate appreciated to 1,344 won as strong dollar momentum persisted despite AI sector strength, with Korean won limited by rising U.S. Treasury yields. High-yield savings accounts and deposits exceeding 4% annual returns are attracting increased investor interest as market volatility reshapes asset allocation strategies.
sections.Industry & Technology: Busan's Gumsaem High School is establishing Korea's first power semiconductor vocational program to develop specialized technicians for the critical foundational technology used in electric vehicles, AI, and renewable energy sectors. Industry concerns are mounting over government plans to lower electricity demand forecasts in the 12th basic power supply plan, fearing a power shortage could impede AI data center and semiconductor investments within a decade. V One Tech's subsidiary secured 3.4 billion won in semiconductor material processing equipment orders, while Chinese battery makers CATL and BYD collectively captured 44.5% of non-China market share in the first nine months, compared to 26.5% for Korea's three battery manufacturers combined.
sections.Real Estate: South Korea's unfilled housing inventory reached 16,000 units while Daegu, North Gyeongbuk, and South Gyeongnam experienced a 41% decline in jeonse and monthly rental listings, reflecting reduced price appreciation expectations in regional markets. Expert surveys reveal that only 1-2 out of 10 real estate professionals and agents expect Seoul apartment prices to stabilize next year, with market consensus differing sharply from government expectations of stabilization within this year. Gyeonggi Housing and Urban Development Corporation is launching Korea's first equity accumulation housing model with 240 units in Suwon's Gwanggyo New City, featuring 10-year resale restrictions and 5-year residency requirements.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration threatened to terminate preferential tariff benefits for South Africa and Rwanda, citing threats to American interests and discrimination concerns, potentially eliminating up to 10,000 South African jobs amid the nation's 30% unemployment rate. Deficit hawks within the Trump camp are pushing for fiscal contraction from current 6% of GDP to 3%, raising concerns about additional tariff increases to fund stimulus spending amid contentious congressional political divisions. The EU introduced a new 2-euro processing fee for e-commerce imports effective November 1st, compounding challenges for Korean fashion and beauty companies following July's provisional tariffs and imposing stricter customs procedures.
sections.AI & Economy: Anthropic's IPO is emerging as a catalyst for reassessing the AI industry as hyperscale tech companies including SpaceX, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Meta demonstrate strong AI infrastructure demand through record cloud revenue growth. LG Uplus reported 84.1% year-over-year operating profit growth to 297.6 billion won in third quarter, driven primarily by AI data center business momentum despite slowing telecom service revenue. China's government is strengthening surveillance and early warning systems to mitigate AI-driven employment disruption while advancing social security enhancements and new occupational training programs. Obigo is expanding its physical AI solutions beyond automotive software to power and energy infrastructure management, capitalizing on growing importance of AI data center related infrastructure.
sections.Others: Rising interest rate pressures present significant risks to tech sector valuations, with concerns about 2 trillion dollars in market capitalization evaporation amid energy shocks from Iran tensions and trade policy uncertainty fueling inflation concerns. South Korea's Ministry of Industry is deploying 650 billion won to expand AI factory implementation strategies, scaling successful artificial intelligence models from individual factories to supply chain partners and industrial complexes. Melania Trump is mediating direct negotiations between Russian and Ukrainian delegations at the White House on November 5th, signaling potential diplomatic momentum. Mashup Ventures invested in Korean AI-powered commerce startup Termite, which develops marketing content creation agents capable of producing online sales content including detailed product pages and video content within three minutes.
